{{#if:{{{3|}}}|<span class="tab_tab {{#ifeq:{{{2}}}|{{{1}}}|tabselected}}">{{{3}}}</span>}}<noinclude>

==Purpose==
Properly formats the tabs. For use with the [[Template:Tab|Tab template]].

==Usage==
::'''<nowiki>{{</nowiki>Tab/Tab '''| ''number'' | ''default'' | ''tabtext'' }}

*'''number''': The number of the tab
*'''default''': The number of the tab to select by default
*'''tabtext''': The parameter containing the tab text (eg. {{{tab2}}})

[[Category:Formatting templates]]
</noinclude>
